subject: Wrong room booking
text: Hi Professor, sorry about the mix-up with yesterday's room booking. I double-checked and found that the calendar invite went out with the wrong building, which was totally my oversight. To fix it quickly, could we shift the guest lecture to Thursday, same time, in the east seminar room? That slot seems free, and I can send a corrected invite right away. Please let me know if that still works for your schedule. I'll also ask the team to update the sign-in sheet, and I'll make sure the updated details reach the students as soon as you give the nod.
